items.title: Press the towel
items.body: Squeeze the water out, no rubbing.

items.title: Dry it fully
items.body: Point the nozzle down the hair.

items.title: Cool air last
items.body: A short cool blast to finish.

items.title: Oil on the ends
items.body: 1 or 2 drops, palms over the top.
